name: deny-on-cycles
description: Rejects any claim graph that contains a cycle in the attestation edges. Demonstrates combining the cycle-detector primitive with a policy evaluator so a resolver can fail closed on circular trust.

on_violation.message: Circular attestation chain detected; trust is not well-founded.
Issuer exceeds maximum attestation fanout of 16.
Root issuer must publish a self-attestation claim.

worked_example.comment: Feed this graph into claim-graph-resolver with policy=deny-on-cycles. The resolver calls cycle-detector on edges of predicate 'attests' or 'delegates-to', then runs the fanout and root checks. Any cycle yields CCG_CYCLE_DETECTED and the resolver returns { ok: false, code: 'CCG_CYCLE_DETECTED' }.
